name: townbox/ava
title: townbox/ava
summary: Hugging Face's Victor Mustar shows Ava, a voice-chat avatar where speech understanding, the reply and the animated head all run on the user's device in the browser. It chains Liquid's LFM3-Omni with Hugging Face's WebGPU kernels and the TalkingHead and HeadAudio libraries, and a live Space is public. The author calls it a tech demo; the model download is about 1.6 GB.
